Title: Initialize repo & branches
Description: Create `main` (protected) and `dev` branches. Configure branch protection on `main`.

Title: Run API and add healthcheck screenshot
Description: Run `uvicorn backend.api.main:app --reload` and hit `/health`. Add a screenshot to the repo Wiki or issue comment.

Title: Set up CI on GitHub
Description: Push repo, verify Actions run tests. Fix any failing tests in `backend/tests`.

Title: Draft security & privacy policy
Description: Create `docs/security_policy.md` with RBAC, data-classification, secret handling, and logging levels for dev/stage/prod.

Title: Finalize Intake SOP v1
Description: Use the provided SOP starter; define intake fields, eligibility rules, and escalation steps. Store at `docs/sop_intake.md`.

Title: Eligibility script for Case Type A
Description: Draft yes/no + date-bound questions for first target mass-tort. Deliver `docs/eligibility_caseA.md`.

Title: Eligibility script for Case Type B
Description: Repeat for second case type; ensure branching logic and disqualifiers. Deliver `docs/eligibility_caseB.md`.

Title: Add CODEOWNERS and PR template
Description: Create `.github/CODEOWNERS` and `.github/pull_request_template.md` based on dev standards.

Title: Document local dev commands
Description: Add common commands to `README.md` and `scripts/setup.sh` notes (run, test, lint).
